# appsignal_uptime_monitor (Data Source)

An uptime monitor of an app, looked up by id, name or url. Useful for monitors made outside this configuration, such as in the AppSignal UI or by an operator. A name or url must match exactly one monitor of the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A monitor made elsewhere (AppSignal UI, an operator), for example to show on a status page.
data "appsignal_uptime_monitor" "web" {
  app_id = data.appsignal_app.web.id
  name   = "www.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String)

### Optional

- `name` (String)
- `url` (String)

### Read-Only

- `check_body_content` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Request headers sent with every check.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `monitor_ssl_expiration` (Boolean)
- `notifier_ids` (Set of String)
- `regions` (Set of String)
- `warmup_duration` (Number) Minutes a check must keep failing before the monitor alerts.
